packageRules.description: Runtimes and package managers get a PR each — they ripple into the CI image, server/go.mod and web/package.json
The rest of [tools] is CLIs driven by mise tasks (air, atlas, goose, ginkgo) — ship them as one PR
go: backend tools are handled by the custom manager below — the built-in mise manager passes the command subdirectory to the Go datasource, which returns no result
A major bump moves the /vN segment, which lives in the tool name rather than the version, so mise.toml needs a hand edit Renovate cannot make

customManagers.description: mise go: backend tools — re-extract with the command subdirectory trimmed to the importable module path
